locatorConvention: Zero-based parsed data-row index excludes header. Physical end line is one-based in the original CSV, including multiline fields. SHA-256 hashes exact csv-parse raw record bytes including its original trailing line terminator. Nonempty field values are lossless; omitted CSV fields were empty.
acquisitionCodeQualification: The original preflight repositoryBaseCommit identifies repository HEAD during acquisition. The executed recipes are separately hash-pinned inside their retained input archives. Failed requests remain failed. This offline run code_commit identifies interpretation code, not a new provider acquisition.

sourceFields.SampleCollectionMethod/MethodDescription: Fish and Ephibenthic Invertebrate Collection Fish trawls were conducted at each site to collect fish/shellfish for community structure and abundance estimates, target species for contaminant analyses, and specimens for histopathological examination. Trawls were conducted by using a 16-ft otter trawl and the duration of the trawl will be for 10±2 minutes; replicate (two) trawls will be performed. In open water, the trawl should be conducted in a straight line with the site location near center. The speed over bottom should be approximately 3-4 knots.
